scope: Stage C only, independent K1 model; no soccer integration, impacts, or training

criteria.tracking_mean_error: max(.05 m/s or .08 rad/s, 30% of command)
criteria.zero_recovery: last 2s mean vx/vy <= .05 m/s, wz <= .1 rad/s, z >= .45m, tilt <= 10deg; each post-motion stop requires 1s of consecutive slow .2s bins
criteria.saturation: raw PD demand reaches task effort limit, each physics substep; does not by itself label a fall
